newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's NLCF buys 2,996 tonnes of pork.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's NLCF buys 2,996 tonnes of pork.

text.p: South Korea's state-backed National Livestock Cooperative Federation said on Wednesday it bought 2,996 tonnes of pork -- collar and picnic -- for shipment in October.
An NLCF official said it bought 1,194 tonnes from Denmark pork, 594 tonnes from Taiwan, 485 tonnes from Canada, 417 tonnes from the United States and 306 tonnes from Britain.
The official said average purchase price was about $3,070 per tonne, C&F.
The shipment was slated for October 18 and 31 to Seoul and Pusan.
